parameters.name: CompliancePackId
parameters.description: The ID of the compliance package to which the rule belongs.

parameters.name: ComplianceType
parameters.description:
The compliance evaluation result of the rule. Valid values:

- COMPLIANT: The rule is compliant.

- NON\_COMPLIANT: The rule is non-compliant.

- NOT\_APPLICABLE: The rule is not applicable.

- INSUFFICIENT\_DATA: No data is available.

parameters.name: ConfigRuleState
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- ACTIVE: The rule is active.

- EVALUATING: The rule is being evaluated.

- INACTIVE: The rule is inactive.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

- 1: High risk.

- 2: Medium risk.

- 3: Low risk.
